Yes, you are right. A movie would suck. However, if done correctly, I think it would do very well as a tv series. If the right actors were found, preferably some who are not already famous, I think it would be an instant hit. Consider shows like Once Upon a Time. People are clamoring for this sort of thing! And they would be able to take their time. If the show does well, they could have years to put all the books onscreen, and not scrimp on the details! Take shows like Smallville. If a show about teenage superman can keep going for more than eleven seasons, getting this one there should be a breeze!
